reviews.text:
I want to thank the entire exceptional team who supported my dog ​​from beginning to end.

And who even took the time to write us a letter after the loss of our dog.

We sincerely thank you for your touching compassion. 🙏🏼
Excellent veterinary practice, competent and pleasant!
Friendly and available team
They have been treating my cat, who has recurring health problems, for several years. They are available, competent, kind, and patient.

I'm giving them two stars because initially they were very welcoming, clear, etc., but over time everything deteriorated. They became incredibly cold. In five months, over three consultations, I've had to see three different vets. I have to find my own way to get proper explanations about my cat's ultrasounds, and I don't understand their changes in behavior.

I have no choice but to continue with them; my cat's illness was discovered there, and it's the closest clinic to my home, which is difficult without a car.

Hello Daniele,
Thank you for this very positive review!
Take care of yourself and your pet! 🐾 The Mon Véto Paris 14 Team …

A huge thank you to Dr. Riviere who treated and cured my cat, even though he was quite ill during our first visit. She implemented an effective treatment protocol that saved him. During follow-up visits, my cat improved steadily until he was fully recovered. She is a calm and truly effective veterinarian. The veterinary clinic is modern and clean, and the staff is welcoming and kind. I'm so glad I found this clinic.

Our veterinarian, Dr. Chloé Rivière, provided excellent advice and took a lot of time to examine our cat, answer our questions, and understand our situation. All the staff were very friendly and patient. A big thank you to you all.
This clinic is truly amazing! A friend recommended Dr. Perichon to me, and I understand why. She's lovely, gentle, caring, and a great listener. You immediately feel at ease. I recommend her 1000%!

What a fantastic clinic! I discovered it by chance after my dog ​​had just had an accident. We received excellent service and a quick and accurate diagnosis. Thank you again to the entire team for their kindness and professionalism! I highly recommend them! A big thank you to Dr. Tsyen
Really nice place, the staff were extremely kind.

Excellent welcome, friendly and competent staff. They took great care of our four-legged friends' needs.
I recommend this establishment.
Kind, professional.
A huge thank you to Dr. Tsyen who made this stressful moment much more pleasant, both for me and for my cat 🙏🏼 …
Excellent! In every way. Professionalism, kindness, respect for animals, and great empathy with clients. Special mention for Dr. Perichon and his assistant, Miss Romane. A big thank you!

By far the best clinic in the entire neighborhood!

It's hard to express just how exceptional this veterinary clinic is—both in its competence and its warm, welcoming atmosphere.

From the moment you arrive, you feel a rare kindness: the staff is attentive, patient, and deeply respectful of both the animals and their owners. The veterinarians themselves are distinguished by their remarkable expertise, but also by their sincere and compassionate listening skills, which are becoming all too rare these days.

Here, they don't just treat; they take the time to understand, explain, and support.
You can tell that the animal's well-being comes first—far before any commercial considerations.

They readily offer payment plans, proof that they place compassion at the heart of their practice.

It's a passionate team, united by their love of animals, and it shows with every visit.

From the initial welcome to the treatments, everything is done with meticulous care and unwavering kindness. A clinic of exemplary compassion and professionalism, where you can entrust your pet without hesitation. A huge thank you to the entire team, especially Dr. Charlotte Perichon.

In short: by far the best veterinary clinic in the 14th arrondissement.
Chloë P. (And Frida)
Due to a move, I tried this clinic for my two cats, Mistinguette and Melcocha, for their annual check-up. I am very happy with the results; the staff is very kind and attentive.
I brought in a kitten I found abandoned/lost in the street, and Dr. Perichon received us with great care and love for her first consultation. I highly recommend him!

Hello Ms. Chung,
Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We are delighted that you were satisfied with our services. Your trust is very important to us.

Sincerely,
Veterinary Clinic Paris 14 Sarrette

Thank you to Ms. Da Cunha for this very reassuring visit with our cat Mimi. She took the time to fully understand the situation and cared for her with great attention and gentleness. She also explained very clearly what was wrong with our cat.
The reception at this clinic is excellent. Thank you again.
Friendly welcome, very professional, the clinic is clean

Fantastic clinic, the whole team is lovely.
We rescued a kitten stuck in rat glue and had a rather large wound on its paw. Dr. Forterre, who is very professional, passionate about his work, and very gentle in his explanations, kept her at the clinic for five days to try to cure the infection, which had spread to her bloodstream.

I thank all the staff who took care of her. Unfortunately, the infection was too severe, and she passed away.

Excellent clinic with competent staff and veterinarians. It's just a shame and I'm upset to learn of the departure of Doctors Forterre and Mauverou. I wish them good luck in their new venture and hope that other doctors will join the team.
My vet for over a year now, all the staff are extremely welcoming, caring and kind. I go there regularly to pick up my orders from Place des Vets (kibble and wet food).

Dear Mr. Barbier,

Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We are delighted that you are satisfied with our services. Your trust motivates us to offer the very best for your four-legged companions.

See you soon!

Veterinary Clinic Paris 14 Sarrette
The atmosphere was poor compared to what I experienced when this clinic first opened, which was very welcoming.

Hello,
Thank you so much for your 5-star review! We always appreciate hearing about your satisfaction.

Sincerely,
Veterinary Clinic Paris 14 Sarrette

Thank you so much, Ms. Ben Salem, for your kind attention!

We appreciate your trust in us to care for and monitor Ofée.

Your encouragement will, of course, be passed on to the entire team!
See you soon, and please give Ofée a pat from all of us!
First consultation with a puppy. The vet was very attentive and efficient. She dedicated a lot of time to me and answered all my questions. I highly recommend her.

Dear Selma Chababi,

Thank you so much for your 5-star review. We are delighted to have been able to … More
Fantastic team... excellent follow-up. The health and well-being of the animals come before billing. Well done! I recommend them without hesitation. True professionals.

Adorable, very professional; I had to euthanize my little Yorkshire Terrier on April 9th. The vet was kind and particularly patient with my crying son; this was followed by such a touching letter (see photo). I will continue to bring my other dog 🐶 with pleasure. …
Dear Kevin, we sincerely thank you for your positive feedback and your trust in our veterinary clinic. Best regards, Sarrette Veterinary Clinic

Absolutely unprofessional, avoid at all costs!!!!!
We ended up with a cat suffering and needing emergency surgery at another clinic due to their lack of professionalism, despite numerous appointments! …
